description: Rules for map NPCs (enemies and characters placed by the maps' spawn tables). Distances are metres on the ground plane (the engine squares them). A spawn row becomes a live NPC when the player is inside the spawn ring (ring_outer) and, on entering a room, outside ring_inner; with the thinned fog (long view) the ring is wider (long_view_*) and the NPC must be out of the camera's view. A live monster is freed past the despawn distance (nearer for a corpse). cooldown_ticks holds a slot back after it spawned, so a spawn and a despawn on the same frame cannot oscillate. radio_range_sq is the squared reach (square metres) of the radio static; hide_distance the fog edge past which a monster is not drawn. Character names are chara/ ids (silenthill:Cybil). The keys starting with '_' explain the key of the same name. Every key is checked. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
_state_restart: Characters whose state machine is restarted on a first behaviour tick so its entry status fires once: session = the first tick the character runs while the game is up; spawn = once per spawn in one of the first spawn_slots NPC slots, while the control state is still zero (a cutscene hand-over sets the step itself).
_kill_tally: A kill credits the ranking's melee or ranged kill count when the killing attack is one of the first player_attacks entries of the attack table; an attack whose table state is ranged_state counts as ranged.
